Touchscreen Navigation System with 30GB hard drive and rearview camera.
Dynaudio® Premium Sound System with 10 high-end speakers (4 tweeters, 2 midrange,
4 woofers) plus 600-watt amp, and Digital Sound Processor technology.
Wheels. Four Autobahn-tested styles available, depending on trim kit.
MDI with iPod® cable lets you plug and play your iPod into the touchscreen Premium VIII radio.
Seamlessly navigate via iPod playlists, albums, song titles, and more.

The Carbon Neutral Project is a partnership with Carbonfund.org, designed to start addressing
the issue of carbon emissions. With their help, we’ll be making it easy for anyone who owns a
Volkswagen to determine their vehicle’s carbon output and take action towards offsetting it.
So far, the VW community has planted over 300,000 trees and offset 419,343 tons of carbon.
And that’s just the beginning. Learn more at vw.com.
The ideas in this book are new. The paper, however,
vw.com is recycled. Please remember to recycle. The book.
Not the ideas in it. Thanks.
